name: branding-charcoal-lime-mist-warm-gray-palette
title: Charcoal, Lime Mist and Warm Gray Palette
whatItIs: Five rounded colour cards on black: tall Charcoal, tall pale Lime Mist, a white card over a Graphite card, and a tall Warm Gray, each labelled with a name and hex code.
whatItMeans: A palette of warm neutrals with one pale acid lime feels calm, natural and modern. The uneven card heights add rhythm.
techniques: Cards of different heights arranged in a bento
Names with hex codes in the bottom-left corner
Pale lime used as the single accent against dark neutrals
Big corner radius across the set

vocabulary.definition: A colour block with its name and code.
A grey with a slight brown or yellow undertone.
A very pale colour that behaves almost like a neutral.
